orca_control.configuration_notes: Source-based scalar baselines. All arms normal CUBIC startup; no pre-policy window assistance. Orca control/moving differ ONLY actor-loss forward flag plus identities/endpoints. Shared unchanged raw reward, conditions, optimizer, replay, update rule, exploration, physical exposure. Canopy QC uses artifact loss centers, moving-stat bound engineering, independent Adam. One seed; no exact-paper-reproduction or convergence claim.
